findings.detail: Competitor observations are not constrained to the product currency and no FX normalization is present.
The price-gap loader does not filter inactive or untracked mappings.
The price-gap loader does not exclude unavailable competitor observations.
The sales query does not filter completed/paid invoice state or cap records at the current time.
Latest-created forecast selection does not exclude target dates already in the past.

AI sales trends read invoices and invoice_items while imported transaction rows are a distinct source. Safe PostgreSQL fixtures were added but could not run without pytest and a dedicated test database.
AI JWT authentication exists, but no Node customer route applies business_recommendations entitlement. Direct AI endpoint subscription exposure policy remains unresolved.
No customer recommendation API client/page is wired; existing recommendation card contains static sample copy and is not rendered by DashboardHomePage.
